tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently purchased a piece of furniture for your off-campus apartment from an online store called "Home Comforts." When the item arrived, you discovered that it was damaged during shipping. You need to contact customer service to resolve the issue. Write an email to the customer service representative, Ms. Brown.
bullets: Describe the item you purchased and the damage it sustained.
Explain why you are disappointed with the situation.
Suggest a resolution for the problem.
tasks.subject: Damaged furniture item
